# equin-site

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The equin site's page actions in the browser extension, over one address model (core: parseEquinAddress / formatEquinAddress) that reads any equin page as an instance (a worktree, main, equin.ai) × a view (an app page, the live demo of it at /about/demo/at/<place>, a website page). Each action moves ONE axis and keeps the other, so a page offers at most three rows, each subtitled with where it goes: Open on main (a worktree's page), Open on equin.ai (a local page — an app page opens in the published demo, as equin.ai serves no app), Open locally (on equin.ai, main), Open in the demo (an app page) and Open live (a demo page — equin.ai's on main). The site mapping is the website's own (apps/website/shell, live-demo core); this leaf only offers it, so the website's composition never carries the extension.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `BrowserExtension.PageAction` "equin: Open in the demo"
    - `BrowserExtension.PageAction` "equin: Open live"
    - `BrowserExtension.PageAction` "equin: Open locally"
    - `BrowserExtension.PageAction` "equin: Open on equin.ai"
    - `BrowserExtension.PageAction` "equin: Open on main"
  - Uses: `companions/browser-extension.BrowserExtension`
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `apps/website/crawlable.WEBSITE_BASE_PATH`
    - `apps/website/live-demo.demoPage`
    - `apps/website/live-demo.demoPagePath`
    - `apps/website/shell.isLocalAppUrl`
    - `apps/website/shell.isPublicSiteUrl`
    - `apps/website/shell.publicSitePageUrl`
    - `apps/website/shell.publicSiteRoutePath`
    - `infra/launcher/gateway-port.pagePort`
    - `infra/namespace.MAIN_WORKTREE_NAME`
    - `infra/namespace.Namespace`
    - `infra/namespace.namespaceFromHost`
    - `infra/namespace.namespaceUrl`
    - `primitives/pane.readEmbedTail`
  - Exports (types):
    - `EquinAddress`
    - `EquinInstance`
    - `EquinView`
  - Exports (values):
    - `flipView`
    - `formatEquinAddress`
    - `mainInstance`
    - `moveInstance`
    - `parseEquinAddress`
    - `sameInstance`
